description: This source file defines structures and functions for managing device authentication tokens, including serialization, storage, retrieval, normalization, and clearance operations within a device-specific context.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a device authentication token for a specific device ID and role.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores a new device authentication token with specified device ID, role, token, and optional scopes.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the token associated with a specific device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace characters from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace and filters empty scope strings, then sorts and deduplicates the list.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the device auth store JSON file.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the device auth store JSON file into a `DeviceAuthStoreFile` object.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the `DeviceAuthStoreFile` object to disk, ensuring directory creation and setting permissions.
